headline.purpose: Section h2; the about h2 drops to clamp(40px,10.5vw,64px).

title.purpose: h3 in steps (clamp(32px,8.2vw,42px)); trailer-carrier note and form titles 28-38px.

list-item.purpose: Serif rows in ruled lists (about facts 600 at clamp(24px,6.4vw,30px)/1.25).

route-label.purpose: Serif 600 25px labels in the hero route card; the wordmark 'Shamrock' shares the size.

lede.purpose: One sentence under an h2, max 34ch, soft color.

body.purpose: All reading copy; 19px from 760px. Never under 17px.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked sans: wordmark sub-label (12.5px .2em). Never sentences.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Green button. Known defect: black alpha breaks Never-Black; retint from ground-deepest (rgba(6,26,19,...)). Do not copy.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: 1px button lift (.5s). The only transform on the page.

motion.name: lane-divider
motion.purpose: Seams are drawn once and redrawn only on resize; no animation.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: CSS transitions collapse, smooth scroll off.

motion.name: still-page
motion.purpose: No canvas, no rAF, no scroll effects, no moving imagery. Add no animation.

components.name: Trailer-carrier Note
components.description: Paper stationery card on ivory with a double gold hairline (1px border plus 1px outline inset 9px), 6px radius. One of only two cards on the site; future rates use this style.
components.html:
When a trailer carrier is the better choice

  • The lowest price matters more than when the car arrives.
  • The car doesn't run.
  • It's a collector car you'd rather not put miles on.

For everyone else, having your car driven down, packed, by one person is the easier way.

narrative.northStar: Hotel Stationery for a Night Drive
narrative.overview:
The page is the stationery you'd find in the glovebox of a long night drive: ivory and paper sheets, thin gold rules, a serif that looks engraved, deep Irish green for the night. The first screen is a light paper sheet with a still route card on it, a gold dotted line from New Jersey down to Florida with Ed's car on the line. The night-drive spirit is carried by the green sections, the lane-line seams between them, and the motto from Ed's card in the footer, not by moving imagery.

The page alternates paper and green grounds, joined by wavy lane-line seams: paper hero, green "How it works", ivory "Meet your driver", green rates and text form, deepest-green footer. Structure comes from rules and type, not from boxes: lists are ruled, sections are full-bleed, and only three objects on the page are cards (the route card, the trailer-carrier note, the estimate form). Type is big for a 40-70 reader on a phone: body never under 17px, primary actions 60px tall.

Nothing on the page moves. There is no canvas, no animation loop, no scroll effect; the only transitions are the hover/focus outline ring and a 1px button lift. The audience is 40-70; nothing should need to be learned, dragged or opened to be read.
keyCharacteristics: Light paper hero; deep Irish green sections, never black; ivory and paper for reading sections.
Cormorant display with one gold italic turn of phrase per heading; system sans for everything read or tapped.
Thin gold rules, double-hairline stationery cards and still dashed gold lane markings as the only ornament.
One green pill Call button per block, with an underlined text link as the quieter alternative.

rules.name: The Never-Black Rule
rules.body: The darkest value on the page is ground-deepest. No `#000`, no neutral greys; shadows are tinted from the ground green.

rules.name: The Ground-Matched Gold Rule
rules.body: On green, use gold; on ivory or paper, use gold-deep. Same for rules (rule-dark vs rule-light) and text (cream vs ink). Every element picks its pair from the ground it sits on, never across. The lane-line dashes are the one exception: they are road paint, always gold, never text.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: Each heading may turn one phrase italic 500, colored gold (green ground) or gold-deep (paper/ivory). That phrase carries the meaning ("I'll drive.", "full.", "rates."). Never italicize a whole paragraph.

rules.name: The 17px Floor
rules.body: Nothing the customer reads drops below 17px (16px only for the copyright line). Labels are the one smaller register, and they are never sentences.

rules.name: Tight Serif, Loose Sans
rules.body: Serif headings sit at 0.95-1.25 line height; sans copy at 1.5-1.6. The tight leading on display is intentional.

rules.name: The Ruled List Rule
rules.body: Lists of facts (about facts) are rows separated by 1px rules, top rule on the first item, no bullets, no boxes. Row padding 14-16px vertical.

rules.name: No Hidden Content Rule
rules.body: Nothing is tucked behind an accordion, tab or tap. Every answer is visible as you scroll.

rules.name: The Lit-From-Above Rule
rules.body: Every shadow falls straight down with a negative spread, so it reads as ambient light under an object, never a hard offset or a glow halo.

rules.name: The One Ring Rule
rules.body: Hover and keyboard focus look the same: a 2px outline at a small offset. Sections set `--ring` (`on-dark`: cream; `on-light` and the form: gold-deep) and every interactive thing (buttons, text link, top-bar links, big number, footer and form links, inputs) uses it. Don't introduce color-fill hovers.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: These two are the limit: add no new eyebrows, and never set one in caps or tracking. A new section introduces itself with its heading.

rules.name: The Still Page Rule
rules.body: Add no animation. No canvas, no rAF loop, no scroll-triggered effects, no autoplay, no moving imagery. The only transitions allowed are the hover/focus outline ring (0.2s), color and border changes (0.2-0.3s), and the 1px button lift (0.5s on `--ease-out`). Under reduced motion, transitions collapse to 0.01ms and smooth scroll turns off.

dos: **Do** pick color, rule and ring from the ground an element sits on (`on-dark` / `on-light` classes set `--ring`).
**Do** join every new section to its neighbors with a lane-line divider carrying both grounds' hexes.
**Do** keep the primary action a `tel:+17323003835` link in the green pill button, 60px tall, one per block.
**Do** set facts as ruled lists in serif rows before reaching for cards.
**Do** keep body copy at 18px+ and measures at 30-40ch.
**Do** swap Ed's photo into the route card when supplied, keeping the ivory double-hairline frame.
**Do** put new rates in the rates section, in the stationery card style (paper, double hairline, 6px).
donts: **Don't** add animation of any kind; the page is still.
**Don't** use black or neutral grey anywhere, including shadows.
**Don't** use gold (light) text on ivory or paper, or gold-deep on green; it fails contrast on the wrong ground.
**Don't** wrap sections or list rows in cards; the route card, the trailer-carrier note and the estimate form are the only cards.
**Don't** add hover fills or color-swap hovers; hover is the outline ring.
**Don't** make anything draggable, hover-driven or hidden behind a tap; this audience shouldn't have to discover how the page works.
